answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable work bond before it can earn: the bond sits frozen, like water held in a glacier, and is slashed if the same operator is caught running duplicate identities. Like a jetty that only lets one boat dock at a time, the bond makes each extra identity pay full price again, so farming a thousand fake agents costs a thousand bonds. Honest agents get the nectar of their work back as the bond unlocks with verified history.
